newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand postpones ASEAN finance ministers' talks.
newsitem.headline: Thailand postpones ASEAN finance ministers' talks.

text.p: Thailand has postponed a regional finance ministers' meeting from next month until early next year because of its forthcoming election, a Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
The general election is to be held on November 17.

Finance ministers from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) were due to meet November 21-23 in Thailand. ASEAN groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
"We have to wait for the new finance minister. The meeting is not expected to be before early February," one senior official at the ministry told Reuters.
The venue for the meeting also has not been decided.
The main topics to be discussed will be the liberalisation of the financial sector and cooperation in monetary and banking policy among member countries.
